title: release-approve.sh: verify the build, sign it with the update key, publish the feed

before.done_when: the script refuses a zip without a valid attestation or with the wrong signing identity, and otherwise writes the appcast item with sign_update and publishes the release

done_when: the script refuses a zip without a valid attestation or with the wrong signing identity, and otherwise writes the appcast item with sign_update and publishes it to the feed the tag names; --withdraw <tag> removes that item from the feed; the test covers refuse, publish and withdraw
body: Recovery from a bad release: --withdraw stops Macs that haven't installed it yet. Macs that already have it get a fixed release with a higher number; a build that can't start can't fetch its fix, so those Macs reinstall from the download (the README says how).
